subtasks: Cover the blocks from left to right, remember their colors, then uncover them in the order: red, green, and blue.
Uncover the red block on the right by moving its inverted cup back to its original spot in front of it. Leave both other cups in place.
Turn the right yellow cup upside down in its current parking area in front of the exposed red block. Leave the red block and the other two covered blocks in place.
Uncover the green block at the LEFT position using the left arm. Move the leftmost inverted cup forward to its original empty spot. Keep the middle blue block covered.
Uncover the blue block under the middle cup last. Use the left hand to move the inverted middle cup toward the front, leaving green and red exposed. Open both grippers and return both arms to origin.
